component.name: B.LAIR_QT
component.summary: Booru client with a local, tag-indexed library

description.p: Searches several boorus at once and downloads the originals into ordinary folders. The tags go into a SQLite index next to the files, so the folders stay usable by any other program.
Sites that are not on the list are usually one address away: the program probes them against eight booru engines. Anything else takes a short Python plugin.
